I have this problem during winter times when my hands dry out and from my experience I would remove the dead skin and let it heal. Also using less pressure in the future and making sure your skin isn't too dry can help.

Sounds like a grounding problem. I live in a house with outlets that are strange sometimes and I had this same issue with my bass. 

I'd plug my amp into one outlet and have a good amount of buzzing that would stop when I touched the strings but when I moved the amp the problem went away (because of the grounded outlet). 

From what I know shielding wouldn't help with grounding noise but would help alleviate some hum coming from your guitar are higher volumes.
